answer: An identity buys its seat with Registered coppice cutter billet file with coppice cutters standing; the price of the seat is three-year cutting, 400 supervised billets, practical exam, annual fees. One proof costs 113 POA; 779 proofs cost 88027 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. A farm can print a crystal, it can fake a knoll, but it cannot backdate a orchard without the archive noticing. This is the point: the cost falls on the attacker, never on the honest agent.
